last_delivered_candidate.name: Target-Domain HSIC Sensitivity
last_delivered_candidate.upstream_basis: Stable OpenTURNS HSICEstimatorTargetSensitivity, DistanceToDomainFunction, ParametricFunction, SquaredExponential, and HSICUStat APIs close the retained critical-domain sensitivity gap; the checkpoint-to-HEAD development delta was empty

reviewed_candidates.name: HSICEstimatorTargetSensitivity
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable in the installed pin, scientifically distinct from global HSIC and reliability probability, bounded for kernel/permutation work and result size, and matched to the official fixed-seed Ishigami upstream test.

reviewed_candidates.name: StandardSpaceCrossEntropyImportanceSampling
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable and valuable for rare-event estimation, but a scientifically complete reliability extension requires additional stopping, auxiliary-distribution, and degeneracy diagnostics.

reviewed_candidates.name: LHSExperiment and LowDiscrepancyExperiment
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable and useful for engineering design generation, but it needs a retained-design product journey rather than an analysis-only wrapper.

reviewed_candidates.name: RankSobolSensitivityAlgorithm
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable and sample-efficient for first-order indices, but it assumes independent scalar inputs, overlaps the existing Sobol question, and scored 74/100 below the normal admission threshold.

reviewed_candidates.name: HSICEstimatorConditionalSensitivity
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable but more specialized than target HSIC, restricted to the V-statistic, and below the current scoring threshold for a separate first slice.

reviewed_candidates.name: Shapley effects
reviewed_candidates.reason: No stable Shapley-effect API exists in the installed OpenTURNS pin.

reviewed_candidates.name: LineSampling and QuantileConfidence
reviewed_candidates.reason: They moved out of experimental only on the unreleased 1.28 development branch and are not stable APIs in the installed pin.
